description: A fix for undoing a lineup while adding another to it.

changes.message: Undoing a lineup while you add another one to it now ends placing. Before, pressing Next and Done showed an error and left the Create Lineup window stuck.

Dragging on the map to select now works with the text, vision cone, custom shape and agent role tools open. Before, you had to close the tool first. While one of these is open, a drag selects instead of moving the map, so hold Space and drag to move it.
While placing or editing a lineup, drag a box around its agent and ability to select them, then drag either one to move them together. The rest of the page stays locked.
Hush, the new duelist, is in the agent list with all four of her abilities.
Drag on an empty part of the map to select everything inside the box. Click to select one thing, Shift+click to add more, and Ctrl+A to select the whole page.
To move the map, hold Space and drag, or drag with the middle mouse button. A plain drag on the map now selects.
Drag anything you selected to move it all together, and undo the move in one step. Delete removes the whole selection.
Copy with Ctrl+C or cut with Ctrl+X, then paste with Ctrl+V into any strategy on the same map. Pasted things land exactly where they were, pictures and lineups included.
Lineup lines and agents no longer slide off their spots while you edit.
Small custom shapes move when you drag the dot in their middle. Before, the resize handles covered it.
Agents slide straight to their new spot when you switch pages, even with no walking route between the two, such as off the map or on top of a box. Before, they stood still and then jumped.
Icarus asks whether a cloud strategy changed before downloading it again for offline use, and downloads only the ones that did. Before, it downloaded every cloud strategy again each day.
Strategies you move to the cloud stay available offline as part of the move, instead of being downloaded again afterward.

Forgot your password? Choose Forgot password when you sign in and we'll email you a link to set a new one. If you signed up with Discord, use the same link to add a password and sign in with email too.
Lineup videos play from every common YouTube link, including youtube.com/watch and Shorts links. Before, only youtu.be links played.
The installer asks whether to open Icarus when it finishes.
A duplicated strategy keeps its pictures. Before, the copy showed "Image unavailable", and deleting the original removed the pictures for good.
Deleting a folder now deletes the folders and strategies inside it, as the dialog says. Folders that earlier deletes left hidden show up again at the top of your library.
A broken shared strategy or folder can no longer stop your cloud library from loading.
Icarus tells you as soon as your cloud session stops being accepted, instead of showing Synced.
Signing up with an email that already has an account tells you to sign in instead.
Undo removes a Ctrl-drag copy in one step, instead of leaving a hidden copy behind.
Your default map theme stays set when you change another setting.
Pictures on strategies use far less memory, and big libraries, folders and lineup pages open and save faster.
Editing a page with teammates uses less data while you drag.
Security and privacy fixes for image file names, the updater, and the avatars other people's apps can see.
Sign in with email or Discord to save strategies to your account. They sync to every computer you use and to the web version of Icarus.
Your existing library stays on this computer. To bring a strategy or folder into your account, right-click it and choose Move to cloud, or drag it onto a cloud folder.

Keep working without a connection. Your cloud strategies stay on this computer: open them, edit them, and add, rename, move or delete pages, and it all syncs when you're back online. If a teammate changed something you changed offline, Icarus asks before replacing it. Creating, sharing and moving strategies in the cloud waits for the connection.
Share a strategy or folder with a link. Choose who can edit, see everyone who has access, and remove people at any time.
Plan together live: see your teammates' cursors and names, and an outline around anything they're changing. Their edits merge with yours item by item.

Watch your VALORANT replays on the map in the new Replays tab, then press Capture to turn any moment into a strategy page. Drop a .vrf file anywhere in Icarus, or open it from Explorer. Works with replays from VALORANT 13.08, and from 13.06 and earlier.

Review a round in the replay: press 1 to 0 to watch one player, see how each round ended and who killed whom with what, filter the killfeed for kills, the spike and abilities, and draw on the paused replay with the editor's pen.
Replays show who's flashed: their view cone shrinks away, their icon washes white with a crossed-out eye, and its outline fills as the flash wears off.
Keep replays Valorant might clear with the Keep button, and remove ones you don't need. Removed replays go to the Recycle Bin.
Deleted pages stay in Recently deleted for 30 days, so you can restore them.
Placed lineups are locked so they can't be moved by accident. Use Edit placement to adjust them, and copy lineups and images to the next or previous page.
Turn any placed ability with X.
Circles now grow to 110 m, enough for Brimstone's and Clove's smoke range, and Vyse's Shear can be shortened like Cypher's Trapwire.
Give agents VALORANT's new Warden rifle from the Weapon menu.
Share map themes as profile codes, try the new built-in Lotus Moss theme, and dim or hide the background dots.
Save screenshots and videos with a transparent background, to lay a plan over your own graphics: tick Transparent background when you take the screenshot or export the video.
Screenshot several pages at once: the camera shows a preview of every page, so tick the ones you want and save them to a folder together.
Export Library and folder export now include your cloud strategies.
A short welcome tour explains what's new. Open it again any time from What's new.
View cones light up the floor the way VALORANT's minimap does: overlapping cones no longer stack into haze, they read on every map theme, and they no longer dim the smokes and abilities under them.
View cones now stop at the same walls VALORANT's minimap uses, and draw faster on every map.
Corrode matches its new VALORANT 13.08 layout, including view cones and the paths agents take between pages.
Omen's Paranoia and Vyse's Steel Garden now match their in-game sizes.
Text and images stay in place when resized on defense, and dragging is smoother with Discord status turned on.
Add bold, italic, headings, bullet lists, and numbered lists to text on your strategies. Use the floating format bar while editing, or type Markdown shortcuts.
Choose game-mode logos for your folders from the new Modes tab: Competitive, Premier, Unrated, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Spike Rush, and Escalation.
Read release notes anytime from What's new next to search in the library.
An Update available icon now stays at the top of the window while an update is waiting, so you can reopen the update dialog after dismissing it.
Find your installed Icarus version at the bottom of Settings. Click it to copy the version for a bug report.

Fixed view cones shifting away from agents and clipping incorrectly against walls when agent size changes. Cones now stay aligned while dragging and during page transitions, including in video exports.
Windows installers and app updates are now digitally signed with a verified publisher.
Windows installers and app updates are now digitally signed with a verified publisher.
Video export now has clearer Potato, Social, and Max quality options.
Exports are more reliable and automatically balance quality and file size.
Agent view cones have simpler controls and can be removed from the agent menu with Undo.
Turn a strategy into a shareable video. Choose which pages to include, set how long each step lasts, and export the animated plan as an MP4.
Settings have been redesigned to clearly separate the current strategy from your app-wide defaults, while custom map themes can now be saved and reused across strategies.
Killjoy's Turret, Cypher's Spycam, Raze's Boom Bot, and Gekko's Wingman can now show where they see or detect players. Vision previews also stop more accurately at walls and corners.
Build multi-step strategies faster by copying placed map items directly to the previous or next page.
Custom shapes are now much easier to resize, rotate, and recolor after placing them on the map.
Viper's Poison Cloud and Toxic Screen can now remain visible as inactive traces, making planned utility states easier to understand at a glance.
Optional Discord Rich Presence can now show friends which map and side you are working on without revealing your strategy or page names.
Added anonymous analytics to help improve Icarus. No strategy content or personal information is collected, and analytics can be turned off under Settings > Privacy.
Updated Veto's Crosscut range to match its latest 30-meter in-game range.
View cones now stop at walls and account for different map elevations, making vision previews more accurate.
Agents now navigate around map geometry during page transitions for more natural movement between setups.
Library sorting and drawing tool preferences are now remembered between sessions.
Resizing abilities and agent markers now keeps them centered on their intended map position.
Dot grids now render with shaders, making strategy boards feel smoother and faster while adding a cleaner animated look.
Dragging items on the map now has more natural tilt feedback, making movement feel more responsive.
Desktop update screens have a refreshed look with smoother progress animation.
Media overlays can now be dismissed with Escape.
Ability and agent tiles now show clear hover labels while browsing, dragging, deleting, or selecting lineup items on the map.
Added real ability names for every agent so hover labels and placed ability details use the actual in-game names instead of generic ability numbers.
Added registry-backed folder icons so folders can use bundled agent role image icons.
Migrated folder icon persistence and archive metadata to stable icon ids with legacy IconData compatibility.
Corrected several ability range measurements, including Killjoy radius conversions, so map previews better match their intended gameplay ranges.
Added Summit as a selectable map with map, callout, spawn wall, ultimate orb, and thumbnail assets.
Updated the map rotation so Sunset and Summit are in rotation, and Fracture and Pearl are out of rotation.
Updated Fade's agent icon.
Fixed Fade's scan radius so it now renders with a visible colored outline.
Updated the map rotation so Ascent is in rotation and Bind is out of rotation.
Fixed an issue where some strategy changes could be dropped when autosave was turned off.
Custom colors.
New UI for selecting abilities easily.
Ctrl-drag now duplicates abilities.
Redesigned pages bar to better reflect current page status.
Made the pages bar resizable.
Revamped settings page.
Custom keybind shortcuts.
Can now turn off agent background color.
Screenshots now show the page title.
Everything looks cleaner and better.
Online is coming soon.

Stack multiple lineup abilities in one place and pick them from a clearer menu, with improved styling and hover feedback.

Export screenshots with options to show or hide the spawn barrier, region names, and ultimate orb markers.
Strategy tiles list agents in role order so compositions are quicker to scan.
Grouped lineup placement with migration from older saves; legacy lineup data is preserved for Hive compatibility.
More reliable lineup editing: better migration change detection, scoped hover updates, cleaner stacked menu hitboxes, and tests around lineup item interactions.
Autosave uses safer deep copies and flushes before exit so you are less likely to lose work when closing the app.
Direct Windows updates verify downloads more reliably before applying an installer.
Stack multiple lineup abilities in one place and pick them from a clearer, easier-to-use menu.
Resize the pages bar and keep your height between sessions; the bar shows two rows when space allows.
Export screenshots with options to show or hide the spawn barrier, region names, and ultimate orb markers.
Strategy tiles list agents in role order so compositions are quicker to scan.
Smoother lineup editing: better migration for older saves, more reliable menus and hover feedback, and fewer stray hitbox issues.
Fixed the direct Windows updater so it verifies every required file before restart, preventing partial downloads from reopening the old version in a loop.
Restored the original desktop updater restart flow to avoid issues introduced by the recent custom restart path.
Added an autosave setting so strategy edits can stay manual when you prefer explicit saves.
Leaving a dirty strategy now prompts to Save, Don't Save, or Cancel when returning to the library, switching strategies, or closing the app.
Autosave now persists in-progress text drafts without committing live edits or resetting the text cursor.
Placed text and images now use world-based sizing so they stay proportional to the map instead of using screen-only dimensions.
Text now scales with the coordinate system and uses a larger default font size for better readability.
Existing saved strategies automatically migrate legacy text and image sizes to the new sizing model.
Map theme profile name fields use CustomTextField / text-editing shortcut overrides.
Redesigned Settings: clearer scope layout, compact sheet, and tidier map theme headers
Ability range and visual state: clearer rendering and context menu integration for placed abilities
Marker sizes stay synchronized when you move between strategy pages
Rotate placed abilities from the board
Ellipse (circle) drawing tool alongside your existing map markup
Drag role icons onto the map like other utilities
Drag-to-attach agent shapes with full undo/redo support
Import strategies by dropping a folder or ZIP; summaries show what was imported or skipped
Archive manifest import and smoother strategy bundle handling
Dead agent state is preserved and interpolated when changing pages
Agent and ability sizing work together more consistently on the board
Added Miks with abilities and updated vision cone labels
More reliable global shortcuts, delete/hover behavior, and lineup cleanup
Undo/redo behaves correctly when edits go out of bounds
Side switching keeps placements sensible; wall and barrier abilities respect the active side
Improved error reporting and dependency updates
Fixed performance issues with the app
Lotus spawn walls are now accurate
Added drag-and-drop import support for folders, nested folder zips, and standalone .ica files.
Imported folder drops now preserve nested hierarchy, including chained subfolders and empty folders.
Drop import now keeps valid strategies when some files are unsupported or from a newer app version, and shows a single summary warning.

Older strategy files, screenshots, and saved data now load and migrate more safely.
Deleted line up items will rotate correctly when flipped when undone, post side(ATK/DEF) change.
Screenshot drawings now render correctly and are flipped properly across sides.
Wall-style abilities now start with better default sizing and are flipped properly across sides.
Ability rotations will now be correctly preserved when undone, post side(ATK/DEF) change.
Release and update delivery has been cleaned up behind the scenes for both desktop and Microsoft Store builds.
